page: Google Cloud Platform n4d-standard-96 is a general-purpose server powered by an AMD EPYC 9B45 processor with x86_64 architecture. It features 96 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 48 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The system is equipped with 384 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4 GB of memory per vCPU. No local storage or GPUs are bundled with this instance.

Performance benchmarks place this server in the top tier for both single-core and multi-core CPU execution, as demonstrated by stress-ng and Geekbench scores. It exhibits strong memory bandwidth, reaching 9925.2 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and over 283 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Cryptographic and vector processing capabilities are enhanced by hardware support for AVX-512 and AES instructions, yielding top-tier results in Passmark encryption and database operations.

This configuration is highly efficient for compute-intensive and parallelized workloads such as software compilation, ray tracing, and text processing. It also demonstrates top-tier throughput for static web serving and Redis operations. While it lacks local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU accelerators, its high-density CPU architecture makes it a cost-effective choice for large-scale general-purpose applications, database operations, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
